description.narrative: The urban commune of Tibiri, located in a region marked by socio-economic and environmental challenges. To this end, the NGO BAOUTAL KASSA is proposing to support vulnerable groups with the support of the Oxfam and Rotab consortium, funded by PASOC IV aspart of the RE.A.G.I.R. project. This project, financed by the European Union and co-financed by Oxfam, aims to promote inclusive and accountable governance, focusing on budget transparency, accountability, food security, gender equality, youth and environmental protection.The community context is characterized by increasing poverty and unfavorable natural and climatic conditions. To help remedy this situation, the NGO BK proposes to implement the following activities:  Information; A mission to identify beneficiaries; Production of small ruminants (sheep) for women; Training women beneficiaries of the fattening kits in animal production; Training women and young people in groundnut and cowpea cultivation techniques; Provision of improved seeds; Capacity-building and awareness-raising for local authorities, communities and grassroots structures on gender, human rights and women's leadership; Radio programs on gender-based violence (GBV) and women's rights; Vocational training for women and young people in the processing of agricultural and plastic waste; Follow-up meetings (NGO, AD, technical services); Post-activity monitoring and expenditure audit. The action is aligned with several priorities of the call for proposals, notably food security governance; women and youth; and climate change and environmental protection. It is based on the concerns of the communities in the intervention zone through the needs expressed in the 2022 - 2026 Community Development Plan of the Tibiri Collectivity. By meeting these needs, the objectives of the CDP can be achieved.The proposed action is aligned with the priorities of Tibiri's 2022-2026 Community Development Plan (CDP), as well as with regional, national and international guidelines. It contributes to improving the living conditions of the population in line with the Economic and Social Development Plan 2022-2026, the Dosso Regional Development Plan 2022-2026, and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).These actions will strengthen the resilience of the Tibiri community in the face of socio-economic and environmental challenges, while promoting inclusive and accountable governance. The action's target groups are women, young people, farmers, local authorities,grassroots human rights structures, natural leaders and local communities. Women Women's needs include access to sustainable livelihoods, training in agricultural and livestock techniques, and economic empowerment.Constraints include limited access to resources,low levels of education and socio-cultural constraints.To help remedy these, the project offers training in agricultural techniques(groundnuts and cowpeas), the supply of improved seeds, the production of small ruminants, and training in waste processing. YouthYoung people need employment opportunities, vocational training and active participation in the community.They face the following constraints: High unemployment, lack of vocational training, social exclusion.The action provides vocational training in waste processing, practical sessions in agriculture, awareness-raising on rights and leadership. Local communities Needs include improved living conditions, access to information, local capacity-building, etc. These communities are confronted with poverty, lack of access to information and a lack of resources.They are confronted with poverty, unfavorable climatic conditions and a lack of effective local governance The NGO BK offers training and awareness-raising workshops on human rights and gender, radio debates on GBV and capacity-building for local authorities, as well as the distribution of improved seeds.The final beneficiaries are women, young people and farmers in the urban commune of Tibiri. They benefit directly from training, kit distribution and awareness-raising activities.Local communities are the indirect beneficiaries of improvements in terms of governance, food security and the environment. The main stakeholders are The NGO BAOUTAL KASSA: this is the key player in the local implementation of activities. Its in-depth knowledge of the field will facilitate the implementation of the action. It will work closely with local communities to identify needs and adapt interventions. Local authorities and community leaders: these provide variable support, sometimes requiring awareness-raising efforts toensure buy-in.As far as the technical and management skills of the target groups are concerned, we can say that women and young people have varying levels of competence, requiring adapted and ongoing training to ensure effective implementation of activities. Through close collaboration with local and international stakeholders, the project aims to establish inclusive and accountable governance, while promoting sustainable development and the empowerment of women and young people.

participating-org.narrative: The NGO BAOUTAL KASSA is a non-governmental organization working to improve living conditions in the Dosso region of Niger. It was founded in August 2004 and recognized by Arrêté N°332/MI/D/DGAPJ/DLP, published in the Journal Officiel under N°17 of 01/09/2005. Itholds PAT N°000451/2022/MAT/DC/DONGAD, and is identified under Fiscal Identification Number N°102484/A of 06/07/2023.The NGO BK hasexperience of implementing activities in the Niamey and Dosso regions. It has representatives in the regions of Agadez and Diffa. However, it is competent and able to operate throughout the country. It is active in the following fields: Environment, Agriculture, Livestock, Health, Education, Vocational Training, Empowerment of women and young people, Resilience to climate change, and Promotion of Entrepreneurship. The NGO Baoutal Kassa aspires to be a leader in sustainable and inclusive development, improving the living conditions of communities in Niger and beyond. Its mission is to contribute to rural and urban development through sustainable and inclusive initiatives. It promotes the following values: Sincerity; Transparency; Fairness; Collaboration; Respect for human rights.Ithas the following governing bodies: the General Assembly, a Board of Directors, an Executive Board, and regional focal points.The NGO BK is a member of the Réseau Santé Niger, made up of four national NGOs, and a member of the Dutch “Power Of Learning” research program on the sustainability and redevelopment of CSOs in Niger, which brings together some twenty national and international CSOs. Its annual budget is made up of membership fees and project funding from donors. Its budget for 2024 amounts to eighteen million five hundred and seventy-six thousand three hundred and ninety-five (18,576,395) FCFA), made up of membership fees and a grant from a partner. The main objective of the NGO BK is sustainable development. Specifically, it pursues the following objectives: - Improve cash crop production techniques;- Contribute to training, informing and sensitizing producers with regard to the sale of their products;- Contribute to food self-sufficiency and seed extension;- Contribute to the diagnosis of terroirs;- Contribute to strengthening the management capacities of producers' organizations;- Contribute to the development of women and children;- Promote personal initiative in entrepreneurship;- Work to protect the environment;- Fight poverty in rural areas; etc.It has expertise in the fields of theenvironment, food security, women's empowerment, education, hygiene and CBO capacity building. Its interests align with those of the partner in the areas of accountability, governance of food security, women and youth, and climate change and environmental protection.
